actions.action: Store findings with explicit scope and passage links
actions.mechanism: Structured population, outcome, timeframe, and conditions prevent similar wording from collapsing differently scoped findings.
actions.implementation: Require exact stored passage IDs for every claim; extract scope only from linked passages, marking unspecified dimensions explicitly.
actions.check: Enter similar claims with opposing findings for adults and adolescents; verify separate records, preserved populations, and rejection of nonexistent passage IDs.
actions.risk: Extracted scope can be wrong; make every field reviewable against its passage.

actions.mechanism: Pairwise comparison separates opposing findings within matching scopes from findings about different populations or conditions.
actions.implementation: Add comparison lanes for matching, different, and unresolved scopes; show opposing findings side by side with passage-ID links opening an in-workspace reader.
actions.check: The adult/adolescent pair must display different populations, not an unqualified contradiction; a same-population opposing pair must retain both findings.
actions.risk: Shared populations alone do not establish comparable methods, outcomes, or timeframes.

actions.action: Build briefings from scope-checked evidence bundles
actions.mechanism: Each statement carries supporting passage IDs; a separate coverage check exposes omitted opposing evidence without treating gaps as refutation.
actions.implementation: Generate only from supplied passages. Flag broadened scope and omitted same-scope opposition; offer a short qualified rewrite. Track unanswered questions separately from claims.
actions.check: Attempt an all-populations statement from adult-only evidence; require revision. Verify opposing adolescent findings remain distinguishable and unanswered questions never become negative evidence.
actions.risk: Automated checks can miss implications; keep linked passages inspectable before approval.
